Each station's antennas work together like a single large dish, so their arrangement directly shapes what the telescope can detect. Fuente: Phys.org.

La estructura medía aproximadamente 200 kilómetros de largo y tenía el aspecto de un enorme vertido que se extendía por el mar. Sin embargo, no era contaminación ni un fallo de los sensores. item.title: Ai Weiwei unveils his epic new Australian work: ‘90% of art is just garbage. Real art questions the existing order’
item.description: From his farm in Portugal, the acclaimed artist speaks about war, peace, the state of the world – and his 40 metre sculpture Mushrooms, on Sydney Harbour “It’s like a film set. Like it’s not real,” the bemused Uber driver says as we pass through a succession of silent rural villages washed with milky sunlight. He’s right: signs of human life are weirdly absent during our windy journey through the Alentejo. I’m making my way to Ai Weiwei’s secluded farm, nestled deep in the Portuguese countryside, where arguably the world’s best known living artist has quietly lived for the last six years… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Michael Donkor

item.description: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast AI hack of Medicare exposes Australia’s vulnerabilities Technology experts have warned revelations an artificial intelligence agent hacked Medicare’s internal systems will not be the only dangerous breach of government data and have called for Australia to boost its protections against the growing risk.
